parameters.name: AccountName
parameters.description: The name of the account to be created.

parameters.name: AccountPassword
parameters.description: The password of the account to be created.

parameters.name: AccountPrivilege
parameters.description:
The permissions to be granted to the new account on the specified database. Valid values:

- ReadWrite
- ReadOnly
- DMLOnly
- DDLOnly

parameters.name: DBName
parameters.description: The name of the database to be authorized.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region where the instance resides.

parameters.name: SecurityAccountName
parameters.description:
The name of the security administrator account.

> If the three-role mode is enabled, this parameter is required. If the three-role mode is not enabled, this parameter is not required.

parameters.name: SecurityAccountPassword
parameters.description:
The password of the security administrator account.

> If the three-role mode is enabled, this parameter is required. If the three-role mode is not enabled, this parameter is not required.
